items.title: Search Grid result layout
items.prompt: Interactive candidate: v2-search-grid-review-v6. This restores the approved compact grid card and expanded state: 56px avatar; founder, company, matched dimensions, and every source attribute on one text axis; borderless More disclosure; and compact grid/list icons.

Approve when: The card makes identity and company immediately scannable.
Matched dimensions are prominent without overwhelming the founder.
The visible facts are enough to compare founders before opening More.
Three columns feel useful rather than cramped at desktop width.

items: The grid hides essential comparison data.
Cards feel substantially slower to scan than the approved list.
The More disclosure or footer actions are unclear.
